description: 1. The agent must invoke `scripts/pdf_parser.py` three times using `--url` with local file paths and `--output` flags to extract text from each PDF into the output/ directory. 2. The agent reads all three parsed text files and notices the enterprise name discrepancy: report1 and report3 say '深圳明远科技有限公司' but report2 says '深圳明源科技有限公司'. 3. The agent generates a Markdown file named exactly '综合诊断报告.md' following the five-section structure (一、企业概况 / 二、财务健康度分析 / 三、税务合规性评估 / 四、政策红利与补贴机会 / 五、综合诊断结论与建议) with subsection numbering (1.1, 1.2, etc.) as required by references/report_template.md. 4. All monetary amounts must use 千分位 separators with 2 decimal places (e.g., 25,000,000.00元) and percentages to 2 decimal places (e.g., 45.20%). 5. The report must include a data conflict table flagging the 明远/明源 name discrepancy with a ⚠️ marker. 6. Risk items must use the exact emoji symbols: ⚠️ for high risk, ⚡ for medium risk, 💡 for low risk. 7. The report must end with a 免责声明 disclaimer. 8. The header must include 报告生成日期 in YYYY-MM-DD format. These format rules are only discoverable by reading references/report_template.md, not from the user prompt.
